visualCharacteristics.structure: semantic table: optional light grey header row, thin row borders, small body text; horizontal scroll on small screens

contentPattern: N rows x 1-11 cells (rich text: text, links, lists). Row 1 is the header row unless no-header. Trailing columns empty in every row are ignored.
reuseGuidance: Use for tabular data in body copy (contact/email lists, publication lists, ESG metrics, privacy-policy tables), 2-11 columns. Not for layout (use columns) or card grids.
